newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias unaware of buy-in plans.
newsitem.headline: Victorias unaware of buy-in plans.

text.p: Philippine sugar miller Victorias Milling Co said on Thursday that it is not aware of rumoured buy-in plans by beverage firm San Miguel Corp or tobacco tycoon Lucio Tan.

The company, which is facing debt problems, called the speculation of the stake buyers "loose talk". Local newspapers have been naming possible suitors for the company, which last week got a 90-day moratorium on debt principal repayments on $168 million of loans.
"VMC is not aware and has no knowledge or information of the two investors referred to (Lucio Tan and San Miguel Corp)," Victorias said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
"If at all, this is loose talk," the statement said.

Analysts have said the company may turn to a stake buyer or an outright merger as it seeks to solve its cash flow problems. Its 32 creditor banks have been meeting regularly to consider a recovery plan for the country's largest sugar miller.
